contexts.text: Beat their spears into sickles ()... Spears = things of such [spiritual] wars. AE 734:3.
They lay hold of bow and spear () = they fight from false doctrine.
Spear () = interior power of truth from good.
The point of a spear is vibrated before their left eye... and then the spear revolves them...
Spear, etc. = all things which are of doctrine.
Spear = falsity of evil destroying good.
That there shall be no combat from any falsity of evil, is signified by He shall cut off the spear ().
The thunderbolt of thy spear () = fatuous goods which in themselves are evils of falsity.
Sword, and spear = falsities from evil fighting against truths from good; and the converse.
The spear (), because it protects all things of the body, = protection in general.
